title: Reoccurring food court/buffet/lunch room area
content: I think I dream of these areas along with college campuses and buildings with multipurpose uses when I'm hungry while asleep There's usually so much food I can't pick what to get 😂 Also, I'm very lonely irl and my mallworlds are communal with a nice social, magical ethereal vibe like I crave irl Old friends or people i don't get to talk to anymore visit me here
